summary: Castor Maritime Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the acquisition of a single 2023-built Kamsarmax bulk carrier for $37.5 million from an unaffiliated third party. The acquisition is a routine vessel purchase funded by cash on hand, expected to close by end of Q3 2026 subject to customary conditions. Post-acquisition, the fleet will comprise 10 vessels. No special-situation elements are present—no tender, no shareholder vote, no activist, no restructuring. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of ordinary business activity. No special-situation classification applies.
